### Youthful Vigor
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/youthful-vigor-one-year-devotions-for-men-november-2.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 34:3
Points:
- Youth is often marked by immaturity, but King Josiah sought God earnestly as a teenager.
- Despite having wicked royal forebears, he took personal responsibility for his spiritual walk and his people's spiritual well-being.
- Acting courageously on the light he had, he took bold steps to eradicate idolatry throughout the land.
- When the lost Scriptures were rediscovered, Josiah immediately responded with humble repentance and greater obedience.
- Believers today have ready access to God's Word and are responsible both to study it and to live it out.
